title: Editorial: add a table for the translate attribute
body:
Per #9832 the `translate` enumerated attribute lacked a table. This PR adds a table for the attribute, enumerating the keywords and states, and describing what each state does.

The prose below the table goes into some more detail about the states, which feels a little redundant, but there is extra information in there so I didn't want to get too liberal with editing it. I'm happy to take direction here if we feel it needs reducing more.
